TAME Space Compass

Privacy Policy

TAME Space Compass prioritizes local use and minimal data transmission. This page is intended for public hosting and App Store Connect linkage.

Data Handling

Current records, notes, floor plan images, and analysis results are intended to remain on device by default.

Only when the user explicitly opens the iOS share sheet will related content be passed to the selected destination through the system share mechanism.

Permissions

  • Location: optional true-north correction
  • Motion & Orientation: compass sensing
  • Camera & Photos: floor plan import and share image export

Third-Party Services

The current local version does not include account login, advertising SDKs, or in-app tracking SDKs. If future versions add external services, this policy should be updated accordingly.

Contact
